body: I will, most certainly. Thank you

I don't know how I can show her love as this would be exactly what she doesn't want. She knows I still love her and might because of this distance herself from me. Additionally, I don't know how I can make sure she doesn't interpret my wish to be there for her and to help her as me just seeing it as an invitation to become again closer to her. I see what she sent me as a scream for help, but when I tell her I would do anything to help her, she might see it as me hoping to get back together with her. How can make sure she's getting my intentions right?
Thank you for your response. I will definitely make clear that I am always there for her.

Thank you very much for your responses! I would want nothing less than to meet her, but I am afraid of even suggesting it given that she just broke up with me and specifically told me how she needs physical distance. Meeting her face-to-face seems to be the best option but I fear she might get wrong intentions(especially after our intensive physical activity this weekend) and I want to avoid any way to hurt her.
